narr: Heavy rainfall associated with Tropical Storm Debby occurred across South Carolina for several days resulting in areas of flash flooding. There was also an isolated severe thunderstorm on the 6th.
ev: City of Orangeburg has closed portions of Riverside Drive due to flash flooding.
SCDOT website reports that Spring Branch Road is closed between Pierce Road and Hunter's Chapel Road due to water running over the road.
SCDPS reported that Bradford Boulevard is washed out near Highway 6.
Broadcast media reported via social media that abandoned homes along Waring Street are being flooded.
A SC highway patrol trooper reported a flooded intersection at John C. Calhoun Drive and Sprinkle Avenue.
SCHP reported flooding along Cabin Creek Road at Gillwood Drive.
Sumter County dispatch reported six inches of water flowing across Cains Mill Road near Nasty Branch.
SCDOT had to close Air Base Road from Cross Hill Road to Horrell Hill Road due to flooding.
SCDOT closed he 900 block of Motley Road due to flooding.
Video sent via X of water flowing across Saddlebrook Lane in Hopkins.
Swan Lake Drive closed due to flash flooding in the nearby park.
SCDOT reports that Carver School Road is closed from Cordova Road to Dry Swamp Road due to flooding.
County Emergency Management reported street flooding in downtown Holly Hill. Several reports of flooded roadways with some areas seeing water up to the door handle of cars.
Video shared via social media of flooding on Bennett Circle with water covering parts of the road and adjacent front yards.
SCDOT website reported all lanes of Britton Brogdon Road between Crossline Pipe and Boots Branch Road were closed in both directions due to flooding. Time estimated.
SCDPS website reported flooding on Porcher Avenue/Eutaw Road near Barkley Street.
SCDPS website reported flooding at the intersection of Jackson Belt Road and Jerico Court.
Clarendon County 911 call center received a call regarding developing flooding near 1208 Seloc Road. Water has filled up ditches on both sides of the road and water starting to cover the roadway.
SCDPS website reported flooding at the intersection of Bunch Ford Road (SC-314) and Gator Drive.
MPING report of flooding received at this location.
SCDOT closed J. Vann Anderson Road near Outen Road due to water overtopping a bridge.
Lancaster County Emergency Management confirmed Van Wyck Road is closed over Twelvemile Creek due to flooding.
Lancaster County Emergency Manager reported flooding across roadways in the Black Horse Run subdivision.
SCDOT closed Old Hickory Road south of West North Corner Road due to flooding.
Picture on social media forwarded by NWS Student Volunteer shows Dutchmans Creek overflowing its banks and causing flooding on Flint Hill Road just after 5pm.
Orangeburg County dispatch reported Freedom Road in Branchville was flooded and impassable.
